    Open penny-farthing, n = 2, no exit at x₀ ([mild] MIPF, case 2) #

    x₀ = x with the loop α (= ρ), x₁ = t, a₁ : x ⟶ t, β : t ⟶ x.

    • no_entry_x: an entry at x₀ gives a tiny point of the reversed penny-farthing.
